item.title: UK prime minister calls actions of Russian warship reckless but not sinister
item.description: UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer says the crew of a Russian warship of acted recklessly in firing a warning shots near a British yacht in the English Channel

item.title: Sudan’s young women return to international soccer as war and taboos linger
item.description: Sudan's under-17 women's national soccer team has made its first international appearance since civil war erupted in the country

item.title: UK military investigates after Russian warship fires warning shots near yacht in the Channel
item.description: A Russian warship has fired warning shots near a U.K.-registered pleasure yacht in the English Channel

item.title: Lebanese lawyers file complaint against banker who met with Israel's Netanyahu
item.description: Lebanese lawyers have filed a complaint against local banker Antoun Sehnaoui for meeting Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu this week in Washington

item.title: 16th century bell foundry adds modern technology to keep casting process alive
item.description: Austria's Grassmayr Bell Foundry has been casting massive bells for churches and cathedrals around the globe for more than 400 years

item.title: Ebola outbreak is worsening food insecurity in eastern Congo, UN agency chief warns
item.description: The Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo is worsening the region's food insecurity, according to the World Food Program's acting Executive Director Carl Skau who described the situation as a “crisis on top of a crisis.”
